reporting_packages.period_orientation: Each monthly package is periods-as-rows (one data row per its own single month) on each statement tab, header row 4, data row 5 -- opposite of the model's periods-as-columns layout; the build transposes accordingly.

sign_conventions.income_statement: Cost of Revenue and Operating Expenses are stored POSITIVE (expense magnitude); Reported EBITDA = Revenue - Cost of Revenue - Operating Expenses (native source formula), reproduced here via the added Gross Profit (derived) = Revenue - Cost of Revenue.
sign_conventions.cash_flow: Beginning Cash, Operating/Investing/Financing Change are stored as signed net changes (Operating Change is negative in months of net cash use); Ending Cash = SUM of all four -- reproduced exactly.
sign_conventions.debt_liquidity: Scheduled Principal is stored POSITIVE (a reduction subtracted in the roll-forward formula: Ending Debt = Beginning Debt - Legacy Debt Payoff + New Facility Funding - Scheduled Principal).

ebitda_bridge.verified_ties_to_certified_covenant_ebit: Zero add-backs found in any of six quarterly Covenant_Calculation workbooks (2025 Q1 - 2026 Q2); FY2024 Reviewed Financial Statements: Revenue 213,000,000.00 - Cost of Revenue 115,020,000.00 - Operating Expenses 64,519,339.31 = 33,460,660.69 = disclosed Covenant EBITDA exactly.

net_debt_and_funded_debt.funded_debt_source: Balance Sheet 'Funded Debt' row, sourced directly from each month's own certified monthly package (NOT from debt-service-schedule.json), per covenant-spec.json step7_signoff decision 'amortization_mechanic_declining_balance': the facility's 0.60%/month amortization is a declining-balance mechanic in the certified figures (verified 18+ months), which the generated schedule's flat-base model cannot reproduce (already ~5.2% too high cumulative by Jun 2026).
net_debt_and_funded_debt.cross_tie: Balance Sheet 'Funded Debt' ties exactly to the Debt & Liquidity block's own 'Ending Debt' roll-forward every month (memo row 25, diff = 0 every month checked) and to all six certified Covenant_Calculation workbooks (e.g. Q1'25 183,924,166.39; Q2'26 168,048,469.80).
net_debt_and_funded_debt.net_debt_row: Balance Sheet row 15, 'Net Debt (derived: Funded Debt - Cash)' = Funded Debt - Cash, added as a real model row per covenant-spec.json#/definitions/Net_Debt's engine-design note (the covenant engine's formula compute only supports op:'sum', so the subtraction cannot be expressed as a covenant-side formula). Verified against all six Covenant_Calculation workbooks: Net Debt = Funded Debt - Unrestricted Cash exactly, Debt check/Ratio check residuals = 0 every quarter.

covenant_support.override_in_effect: NOT POPULATED. covenant-spec.json's sole financial covenant is Maximum Net Leverage Ratio (Net Debt / Covenant EBITDA) -- there is no Fixed Charges / coverage covenant in this spec for 'Cash Interest Expense' / 'Scheduled Debt Principal Payments' rows to bind to. Additionally, the schedule's cash-interest figures are built off a VOID 1bp non-contractual placeholder rate (step7_signoff decision 'interest_rate_placeholder') and its scheduled-principal figures are the same flat-base approximation superseded by the certified declining-balance figures already used for Funded Debt above -- neither would be usable even as reference-only detail.
covenant_support.recheck_on_refresh: If a future amendment adds a Fixed Charges / coverage covenant, or if the true interest rate is confirmed with Granite Harbor Direct Lending, LP, revisit this decision -- a real rate would let 'Cash Interest Expense' be populated from the (then-corrected) schedule.
